summary: Steel tower with a wooden cab, built 1931 at Dolly Sods and moved to Bell Knob in 1943; cab partly collapsed in snow; unstaffed; reached on foot, top locked.

facts.status_note: Part of the cab collapsed under snow; the steel legs, cab platform and stairs remain.

access.note: Reached on foot by a grassy road off Forest Road 19 on Monongahela National Forest land. A 2013 travel post says it may be unsteady.

visit.trail_note: A 2020 Register visit report found the stairs manageable only for the first flight, with the top locked. Do not climb.

events.note: Completed at Dolly Sods (Plains) as a 30-foot steel tower

Cab collapsed under a record snowfall per the Forest Lookouts page and a 2013 travel post; the Register says portions collapsed before October 2015

corrections.proposed: 1931 built at Dolly Sods (Plains); 1943 relocated to Bell Knob
corrections.why: The Register's own text says the tower was built in 1931 and relocated in 1943. The Dolly Sods site record and the Forest Service history agree.

The Register describes 30-foot steel legs, about 9.1 m. No source gives 3 m. A 1956 station description on the Forest Lookouts page says about 70 feet, so the height is not settled; a human should confirm before changing it.

corrections.current: The tower still stands, but its cab is gone (FFLA).
corrections.proposed: Part of the cab collapsed under snow; the steel legs, cab platform and stairs remain.
corrections.why: The Register says portions of the cab collapsed, not that the whole cab is gone.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The Register lists 1943 as the built field, the year the tower was moved. The Register text, the Dolly Sods site record and the Forest Service history all give 1931 as the first build, so 1931 is the built year and 1943 the relocation.
The Register gives 30-foot steel legs; a 1956 Coast and Geodetic Survey description on the Forest Lookouts page gives about 70 feet. Not resolved; height is left out of facts.
The Forest Lookouts page and a 2013 travel post date the cab collapse to 2010. The Register says portions collapsed before October 2015. Both can be true; the 2010 date is the one reported.

notes_for_editor: The 1931 build and 1943 move agree across the Register, the Dolly Sods site record and the Forest Service history, so the history is well supported. Height is unresolved: 30-foot legs (Register) against about 70 feet (1956 station description quoted on the Forest Lookouts page); the record's 3.0 m matches neither, and the proposed 9.1 m is from the Register's legs and needs a human check. The cab collapse year is 2010 in two sources and before October 2015 in the Register. Current condition rests on the 2020 Register visit report and a 2013 travel post; not checked on site. Access (grassy road off Forest Road 19) comes from the 2013 travel post only. The Reddit and abandonedonline pages were not used. Nothing in the 1976 newspaper item was used beyond the employee's remark. No new photos with image URLs were added.
